description: This file defines a LogFile class used for logging purposes, including methods for appending log lines, taking log snapshots, and managing log files. It also defines a LogChunk type and imports external modules and types.

classes.name: LogFile
classes.description: A class for managing log file creation, appending lines, and retrieving log chunks.

methods.name: appendLine
methods.description: Appends a line to the log file asynchronously.

methods.name: take
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the current log as a string, optionally relative to a given path.

methods.name: _take
methods.description: Internal method to generate a LogChunk representing the current log state.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Internal method to write a log line to the file.
